title: ICU 3 South Bed 3: Insulin Infusion Rate Discrepancy

fields.systemName: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center - AOC Console 3

transcript.speaker: Dr. Priya Raman
transcript.text: Carol, it's Dr. Raman. ICU 3 South bed 3 — insulin infusion. The order was 4 units/hr. The nurse found a glucose of 52 at 16:30. The pump log shows the rate at 14 units/hr from 15:58 to 16:29. She says she entered 4.0. I can't confirm whether she mistyped, the pump misread the entry, or the library changed the scaling. The patient is on dextrose and responding.

transcript.speaker: Carol Beckett
transcript.text: Understood. I'll notify the nurse manager and start the root cause review. We're not changing the infusion rate yet — the patient is stable.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Priya Raman
transcript.text: Good. I'll send the log to Clinical Engineering and the ISO. We need to preserve the pump and the server as evidence. The family will need to be informed — we're not speculating on cause, but we're not hiding it either.

instructorNote: This inject tests clinical and operational response to a potential device-related adverse event. Watch for immediate patient safety actions, disclosure to family, and evidence preservation. The CMO must not speculate on root cause.
